fact: Law Lab Africa states that Djibouti's Digital Code (with its 156-article personal-data regime) was adopted 2025-06-30, promulgated 2025-07-06 and published in the Journal Officiel on 2025-09-18, and records the law as in force; it also reports no published enforcement decisions as of 2026-09-28 and the CNDP as still being constituted.
title: Data Protection in Djibouti: Law, Regulator, Enforcement
